messages:
nora: Heads-up: proposing to unpin SDK 4.0.0 from hosted canary tonight at 00:30 UTC. This includes the kvcache refactor that improves throughput but may change warm behavior. Change window 00:30-03:30 UTC. Telemetry: https://telemetry/internal/1798-kvcache-refactor
ash: Important: we saw a small spike in rates of CACHE_MISS for early-warm clients in staging. Need clear rollback gates. @ops-sre will own monitoring?
ops-sre: I'll handle monitoring. Rollback triggers: increase in CACHE_MISS rate > 2x baseline sustained 10m OR customer_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m. On trigger deploybot will pin SDK=3.9.7 for canary cohort and page.
ben: Suggest staged rollout by customer cohort: low-risk tenants first (ci-prefix) at 5%, then broader canary. Also set header X-RW-SDK-Compat: legacy to route known early-warm clients to pinned behavior.
clara: QA note: run synthetic longseq and burst tests against canary path. Testset location: /qa/suites/kvcache/1798. I'll run smoke after 5% step.
nora: Rollout plan: 00:30 start -> 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if green. Release notes draft: /notes/release-1798123456. Adding a short compat note for customers using early warming.
nash: Ops checklist: enable metrics feature.unpin_179812 and set debug trace for kvcache for cohort. Also increase retention for traces to 3h during window.
deploybot: schedule created by @nora. job id: deploy-1798123456-01. To abort: `/deploy cancel deploy-1798123456-01`. Rollback policy attached to job metadata.
ops-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
# rollback
if cache_miss_rate >= baseline*2 for 10m or cust_err_rate > 0.005 for 5m:
  deploybot pin sdk=3.9.7 cohort=canary
  post to #incidents with graphs and sample traces
  escalate to eng-runtime and eng-developers
```
clara: Also watch for client-side timeouts; early-warm clients may surface longer first-token times if miss ratio increases.
ben: I'll prepare a toggle in edge-routing to divert legacy-tagged customers to pinned SDK path if needed.
nora: Support and comms: tagging @support to prepare canned responses and @product for customer impact assessment.
nash: I have a small hotfix branch to add the compatibility header auto-detection if we need to backfill. Will hold until window closes or rollback required.
deploybot: automated update: step1 (5%) scheduled at 1798125000, job deploy-1798123456-01 queued.
ops-sre: standing by to post first smoke status ~00:45 UTC. Please ack if you are monitoring.
nora: ack
clara: ack
ben: ack
ash: ack
